title: BNPL Silver: Late Payment Fees and What Happens If You Miss a Payment
summary: This document explains BNPL Silver late payments: a flat late fee is charged for each installment that becomes past due, and a missed installment is marked past due with additional assessed late fees. It also covers reminders, temporary pauses on new plan access until the account is current, and possible acceleration and account review for remaining balance if non-payment continues.
